pressed.notes: Controlled pressed state; counterpart of defaultPressed.

value.notes: Identifies the toggle when it is used inside a ToggleGroup.

renderProp.elementForm: render={<button />} or any element (nativeButton false then)
renderProp.functionForm: render={(props, state) => state.pressed ? <button {...props}><FilledIcon/></button> : <button {...props}><OutlineIcon/></button>} — the documented pattern for state-dependent content
renderProp.merging: mergeProps; merge-props.md uses Toggle + event.preventBaseUIHandler() as its worked example

controlled.note: Generic over Value extends string. reason is always 'none'.

formIntegration.note: Toggle is not a form control: it has no name/value and does not participate in submission.

keyboard.keys: Native <button> activation; aria-pressed is maintained by the component.

notableDifferences: React Aria's ToggleButton uses isSelected/onChange; Base UI uses pressed/defaultPressed/onPressedChange — 'pressed', never 'selected'.
aria-pressed is emitted (React Aria's ToggleButton also sets aria-pressed when not inside a group).
There is no isDisabled/isPending — plain disabled.
Styling hooks are data-pressed / data-disabled only.
